sentences.text: Allowed subject to all just exceptions.
This is a petition filed seeking quashing of the FIR No. 719/2019 dated 14.12.2019 registered at PS Narela Industrial Area under Section 498A/406/34 IPC.
The FIR is based on two MoUs dated 10.01.2020 and 12.01.2023, pursuant to which the respondent No.2 was to receive a total sum of Rs. 5 lakhs from the petitioner.
A sum of Rs. 3 lakhs has already been paid to the respondent No.2 and the balance sum of Rs. 2 lakhs is being paid today in Court vide DD No. 386588 dated 21.02.2023 drawn on State Bank of India.
The petitioner is present in Court and has been identified by Mr. Dheeraj Kumar, learned counsel.
The respondent No.2 is also present in Court and has been identified by Mr. Tarun, learned counsel and SI Meer Singh, PS Narela Ind. Area.
The parties state that they have arrived at the above said MoUs out of their own free will and without any undue influence, threat, pressure or coercion.
The respondent No.2 states that she has no objection if the present FIR No. is quashed.
There is no child born out of the wedlock.

For the reasons stated above, the FIR No. 719/2019 dated Pankaj Kumar & Ors vs The State ( Government Of Nct Of Delhi) & ... on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112079671/
1 14.12.2019 registered at PS Narela Industrial Area under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
